evals.name: cf-runtime-memory-entitlement-is-in-btp-unit
evals.description: Runtime memory is a BTP entitlement even when it enables Cloud Foundry.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create Cloud Foundry environment
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_environment_instance`, `environment_type = cloudfoundry`, `subaccount = dev-sa`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Assign Cloud Foundry runtime memory entitlement
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_entitlement`, `subaccount = dev-sa`, `service_offering_name = APPLICATION_RUNTIME`, `service_plan_name = MEMORY`, `amount = 1`

evals.prompt: Use per-stage directories and design the Terraform layout.

assertions.text: Annotates the APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY task to terraform/dev/btp/main.tf rather than the CF unit
Preserves amount = 1 in the task metadata

evals.name: state-design-guides-and-records-boundaries
evals.description: Design guides the user to split Terraform state into independent roots and records the decision in governance.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create subaccount dev-sa
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount`, `subaccount = dev-sa`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Create Cloud Foundry environment
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_environment_instance`, `environment_type = cloudfoundry`, `subaccount = dev-sa`
- [ ] T-003 `[dev]` Create hana-cloud service instance
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = btp_subaccount_service_instance`, `location = cf`, `subaccount = dev-sa`

# BTP Governance

## Regions
- Allowed: eu10
- Forbidden: none
- Data residency: EU only
- Compliance reason: GDPR
- Preferred region: eu10

## Naming
- Subaccount pattern: acme-{env}
- Pattern tokens: {env} = environment tier
- Environments: dev
- Directory structure: hierarchical
- Max name length: 60

evals.prompt: Use per-stage directories, design the Terraform layout, and help me split the state into reasonable chunks including a user-defined 'networking' group.

assertions.text: Proposes state boundaries that place BTP-provider and Cloud Foundry-provider resources in separate independent Terraform roots
Treats directory management as a separate state/root from the subaccounts it parents when BTP directories are used
Creates the requested user-defined 'networking' named state group as its own independent root with the standard layout
Records the agreed state boundaries in a ## State Design section of memory/governance.md without removing the existing Regions or Naming sections
Keeps roots independent via manual tfvars handover and does not introduce a terraform_remote_state coupling
